event: Fed's Barr speaks ~17:00 SAST, Goolsbee ~18:15 SAST. Nvidia board news can land anytime. US PPI Fri 13 Nov, 15:30 SAST.

bullets.title: Selling deepened
bullets.text: By 15:20 SAST Nasdaq futures were down about 1.5% and S&P futures 0.7%, as money rotated out of tech (ZeroHedge).

bullets.title: Nvidia board
bullets.text: Nvidia's board met to decide Jensen Huang's future and is reportedly looking at candidates and a temporary CEO (ZeroHedge, GFX FTs).

bullets.title: Downgrades pile up
bullets.text: At least four firms downgraded Nvidia on fears the probe could take five months or more, with results due next week (Investrade).

bullets.title: Claims a bit higher
bullets.text: Initial jobless claims rose 9,000 and beat the 195,000 forecast, a modest rise from near 1960s lows (CNBC).

bullets.title: Fed in focus
bullets.text: Several Fed speakers are out today, and markets are watching for more openness to a 50bp December hike after Tuesday's hot CPI (ZeroHedge).

bullets.title: Not a trend change yet
bullets.text: The Nasdaq was still up about 3% on the week before today, after Wednesday's CoreWeave-led rally (Options Oracle).

buy.title: Buy plan: 27,837-27,957 flush (counter-trend)

keys.label: Buy zone
keys.value: 27,837-27,957, only after the open sweeps your range low

look: Counter-trend against a strong down day. Half size or skip.
The 16:30 open flushes below your range low into 27,837-27,957 and a 5-min candle closes back inside.
Nvidia stops making new lows, or the board gives a clear plan.
AMD and Broadcom keep holding up, so it's not the whole chip sector.
Take some profit at 28,050 and move the stop to entry only after that.
watch: Catching a falling knife: on trend days a sweep of the low often turns into a breakout.
A Nvidia headline during the hour can add another leg down.
Barr at about 17:00 SAST sounding open to a bigger hike.
Moving your stop lower when price gets close.

A short squeeze if the board says Huang stays or names a clear plan.
